description: skypeek: Aurora forecast: the chance of visible aurora at a location in the next 30-90 minutes. For Kp and solar wind use get_space_weather. Returns the chance (0 to 100 percent) of visible aurora overhead at a point from NOAA SWPC's OVATION model for the next 30-90 minutes, with the current Kp, the Sun's altitude and whether it is dark enough. Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (public domain), a derived copy, not an official NOAA product; no endorsement by NOAA or the National Weather Service is implied. The model assumes a dark, clear sky: cloud, moonlight and light pollution are not modelled. Cached up to 10 minutes. An upstream outage is a 503 upstream_unavailable (not charged). Typically under 1 s cached, a few seconds on a refresh. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 5 skypeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/space-weather-kp-index-aurora-api.html
name: aurora_forecast
